## KeyProvider.getPrivateKey() method

Retrieve the private key for signing. Returns a temporary file path that can be passed to OpenSSL. Caller MUST call cleanup() after signing is complete.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getPrivateKey(keyRef: string): Promise<KeyRetrievalResult>;
```
